description: A quiet, earthy bedroom vignette focused on a nightstand and bedside area. The nightstand is a simple, solid wood piece in warm honey-brown oak with a raw, slightly rough-hewn quality. On its surface sit a stack of books with linen and paper covers, a small ceramic mug in terracotta, and a tall rounded ceramic vase in matte sand-brown holding an abundant dried pampas grass arrangement. A smaller companion vessel in a similar earth tone sits beside it. The bed at right is dressed in loose, rumpled layers — natural linen pillowcases in oatmeal, a chunky woven throw in warm greige, and a heathered blanket in muted tones. The wall behind is smooth plaster in warm taupe with a soft shadowed texture. A warm glow emanates from a wall-mounted form just above and behind the nightstand arrangement — a slim vertical element in matte black with a terracotta-orange spherical accent detail and a ribbed or fluted shade — casting a soft downward arc of warm amber light across the nightstand surface. Natural light enters from a window at the upper left, streaking diagonally across the plaster wall. Camera at seated eye-level, tight vignette composition centered on the nightstand and bedside arrangement, normal to slightly telephoto lens, level pitch. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
